name: El rey de la chicha
address: 2101 SW 1st St, Miami, FL 33135, United States
address_source: Google Business Profile (live gmaps_detail.js read). This is a food court / shared lot spot, not an indoor storefront: the cart sets up there most nights.
phone_source: Google Business Profile, re-verified live via gmaps_detail.js
language_evidence: The business's own printed menu board (photographed on their cart, see assets/raw/gmaps-5.jpg, used only as a data source and NOT placed in the site gallery) is entirely in Spanish ('MENU', 'disfruta cada sabor', 'Chicha Venezolana', etc). Google reviews happen to be written mostly in English by customers, but the business's own first-party material (menu, cart signage 'EL REY DE LA CHICHA', 'Chicha Venezolana') is Spanish, so Spanish was set as the default/primary language per DESIGN.md (business's own captions/menu over reviewer language).
has_own_site_evidence: (1) Google Business Profile authority/website field is empty (gmaps_detail.js: website: null; raw page text shows 'Add website'). (2) WebSearch for '"El rey de la chicha" Miami website' and '"El rey de la chicha" Miami instagram OR facebook' and 'site:facebook.com "rey de la chicha" Miami' returned no matching business site, Facebook page or prior Instagram reference at all. (3) curl -I on elreydelachicha.com, elreydelachichamiami.com, elreydelachicha.net: all returned connection failures (000), no DNS/host. No own website found anywhere.

social_media.evidence: Handle read directly off the business's own printed menu board photo (their own first-party material, assets/raw/gmaps-5.jpg shows '@elreydelachicha_mi' / '@elreydelachicha_miami' next to two QR codes). Automated verification of the live profile (node scripts/ig_scrape_fixed.js and WebFetch) both hit Instagram's generic login-wall page (title just 'Instagram', no profile data), so reachability/follower count could not be confirmed live. The handle itself comes from the business's own signage, not a guess, but the profile's current public status is unconfirmed.

email_search_note: No email found. Checked: Google Business Profile (no email field), no Facebook page found (see has_own_site_evidence), Instagram bio could not be loaded (login wall, see social_media note), no linktree/poplme referenced anywhere, no own domain to derive an email from. Contact channel is phone only.

google_business.category: Food court (Google's category for this listing; the business itself is a single Venezuelan chicha/dessert cart)
google_business.hours_note: Google shows an irregular/ambiguous hours block for Tuesday (overlapping ranges that look like a data artifact) alongside clean evening hours the rest of the week (roughly 5-6 PM to 12-2 AM, Wed-Mon). Per the adapted-variant rule, an ambiguous datum is omitted rather than guessed: the site mentions only 'open most nights, Wednesday through Monday' and does not publish a precise hour-by-hour table.

services_source: Exact menu board photographed on their own cart (assets/raw/gmaps-5.jpg, 'El Rey de la Chicha Miami - MENU - disfruta cada sabor'). All names and prices on the site are copied verbatim from that photo: Chicha Clasica Traditional $10.70 (16oz $16.05, 32oz $21.40), Chicha Pro flavors (flips/oreo/piru cream/cocosette/chips ahoy/chocolate chips and colors) $11.70 each, Fresa con Crema (12oz) $12.89, Donas $3.21, Banana Split $13.91, Solimango Picado $8.56, Oblea Pro $9.10, Oblea Clasic $6.96, Granizados (5 flavors: pineapple/blue/cherry/estamberry/sherry x blue) $7.49 (8oz). Nothing invented.

reviews_verbatim.author: Martin O
reviews_verbatim.text: Best chicha in the area!! Soo good, family also tried chantilly cream with strawberries and 'granizado'. Kids went crazy, def recommended. Easy to park next to it, with a chill area to sit down at. Also fast and friendly service, thank you Nelsery and Rey!

reviews_verbatim.author: Eduardo Garcia
reviews_verbatim.text: Feels like being in Venezuela. Best strawberry cream (everything hand made and organic) desert I had in very long time

reviews_verbatim.author: Carlos Chirino
reviews_verbatim.text: Great Chicha. Super nice guy. Five stars Service. He is the real Rey de la Chicha

owner_note: Reviews repeatedly name a 'Rey' and a 'Nelsery' as the people running the cart ('thank you Nelsery and Rey!', 'He is the real Rey de la Chicha'). Used 'Rey' as the first-name caption under the small avatar photo in the Experience section (not a fabricated name, taken directly from two independent real reviews).

gallery.source: node scripts/gmaps_photocycle.js on the Maps listing, 8 raw photos pulled, 1 exact duplicate removed (7 unique), all verified with `file` (valid JPEG, >0 bytes) and viewed one by one with the Read tool before use.

Hand holding the actual dessert in front of the cart signage, appetizing, clean shot.
Close-up product shot, good light, no issues.
Night ambiance shot of the cart and seating area; a customer's hand/bag is in frame but no text overlay, kept as an atmosphere shot per the rules.

used_on_site.used_as: nav logo + favicon + og:image fallback not used (og:image uses gmaps-7.jpg instead)
used_on_site.note: Cropped from the business's own menu board photo (gmaps-5.jpg), isolating just their printed circular wordmark/logo artwork. This is their real logo as printed on their own material, not a generic graphic.

excluded.reason: Full menu board photo: heavy real text/price overlay. Used ONLY as a data source for services/prices and the Instagram handle, never placed as a displayed photo/gallery tile, per the 'no captions/text over photos in gallery' rule.

brand_vibe: light-v2 base, palette shifted (hue 350, sat_mult 1.05) from the template's reference plum-pink toward the warm crimson/red seen on the cart's own signage ('EL REY DE LA CHICHA' lettering, pink flamingo bag, strawberry-cream colors). Vibrant, cheerful, dessert-cart feel on a light cream background, matching their actual branding rather than a generic look.
